title: Indian Navy Launches 'Machilipatnam' ASW Shallow Water Craft & Delivers DSV 'Nipun'
summary: Indian Navy Launches 'Machilipatnam' ASW Shallow Water Craft & Delivers DSV 'Nipun'

items: Machilipatnam (BY 529): Launched 7th of 8 Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Crafts built by Cochin Shipyard Ltd (over 80% indigenous content).
DSV Nipun: Hindustan Shipyard Ltd delivered 2nd Diving Support Vessel capable of Deep Sea Saturation Diving up to 300m depth.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Chief of Naval Staff: Admiral Krishna Swaminathan | Cochin Shipyard HQ: Kochi, Kerala.
